title: Bunny Berigan at the Savoy
summary: Berigan's small group almost ran his band out of the Savoy.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: What about players like Harry James and Bunny Berigan?

Oh, yeah. I was in the Savoy when Bunny Berigan came in with seven pieces. He came in with seven pieces. We had George Auld on tenor, Buddy Rich on drums. I'm trying to figure out, I can't think less than that, 6 or 7 pieces.

Anyhow, this was the first time that we had ever got like they gonna run us out of the Savoy. You know, the Savoy people was with us on account of us being the house band. But, you know, they liked to, they run us out of the Savoy? Bunny Berigan and Buddy Rich and all, they got on there and they sounded like an 18 piece band. They really played. We had a lot of fun. That's when I first met Bunny. And Bunny, he was a real nice guy. I knew him well.
